reviewedEffects.name: Planar Ally (Minor)
reviewedEffects.scope: Summon one Medium Minor Planar Ally with AC 14, HP 24, walking Speed 30 feet, saves equal to owner PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing, and body mass 100 pounds. Its explicit tags are summoned and extraplanar; this spell supplies no additional creature-type classification or world-faction identity. It understands your spoken commands but has no speaking language or telepathy. It has ordinary hands suitable for simple object manipulation. It acts immediately after you. Within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command movement plus its one strike or one basic legal action. Without a command it may defensively move and Dodge. It shares the owner-wide Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action per numbered round.
reviewedEffects.limitations: For noncombat assistance it may carry no more than 30 pounds AND 3 Load, manipulate simple unattended objects with its hands, or Search using its actual +0 check; source-required proficiency is not granted. Ordinary object/cargo/time/action rules still apply. It has no autonomous offense or opportunity attack, free Help advantage, planar travel, flight, special senses, resistance/immunity, supernatural knowledge, telepathy, automatic scouting report, faction/legal authority, contracts, casting, free economic labor, loot, harvestable body, corpse or resource/death triggers. One ally per caster. At 0 HP, expiry or replacement it disappears; ordinary borrowed/carried property is conserved and drops at its last location under normal support/Falling rules. This is a NEW summon-only tabletop profile for the source's intended CR-1 role, not a certified CR-1 Monster Manual creature or a grant to choose any published monster. Do not relabel Umbrin Arachnid or fractional-CR creatures to qualify. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

reviewedEffects.name: Faction Portal
reviewedEffects.scope:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
reviewedEffects.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
reviewedEffects.crossPlanePermission: YES: known receiving faction headquarters may be on same OR another plane, subject to actual positive canonical reputation, receiving point, lawful payload, and wards.

reviewedEffects.name: Planar Window
reviewedEffects.scope: Create one fixed visible 5-by-5-foot viewing window. It displays ordinary vision from the fixed remote point in all directions; observers may direct their attention around that scene without moving the remote point. Anyone who can ordinarily see the local window can see the unprotected displayed scene. Local Blindness, actual visual obstructions and inability to see the window prevent this viewing. Remote light, darkness, smoke, walls and terrain work normally; the spell grants no darkvision or true sight. Separately, you privately detect the location and category of actual native beings and native ongoing effects/phenomena within 30 feet and line of effect of the remote point. Native means a genuine established native/origin relationship to that plane, supported by actual source or setting fiction. This added detection can locate a readable Hidden/Invisible native presence without providing sight of its body. A visitor or a spell merely cast there by a visitor is not thereby native. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. The additional detection does not reveal an otherwise unseen entity solely because its provenance is undefined. Protected presence/location/category fields remain protected independently.
reviewedEffects.limitations: Only you receive native-detection reports; other observers receive the displayed ordinary vision. That private magical detection does not require your eyes or continued sight of the local window, but concentration and the remote 30-foot/line-of-effect limits still apply. Neither point moves, follows a creature/vehicle or searches rooms; ordinary translation of a chosen supporting surface does not carry the fixed window. No continuing 60-foot caster tether is added after legal placement, and no clock pauses on caster travel or suppression. One Planar Window per caster; successful recasting replaces it. Specific planar or information protections filter only their actual scope. The window is nonphysical magic, not a break in either barrier: no sound, passage, physical interaction, attack, remote target permission, line of effect or casting origin is supplied in either direction. It has no HP or harvestable surface and is affected only by an actually applicable detection/suppression/dispel rule. Suppression supplies no backlog or replay. The source’s remote visual scene is public, but it creates no recording object. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

reviewedEffects.name: Arcane Portal
reviewedEffects.scope: NEW two vertical 5-ft-high by 3-ft-wide apertures placed against actually open supported spaces. One willing Small/Medium creature with lawfully carried cargo, combined weight at most 500 lb and actual aperture fit, may step through in either direction by spending 5 ft of permitted movement; then both apertures close. Transit requires available destination support/space and does not enlarge cargo, lift an unwilling passenger or reset movement spent. Occupied/blocked endpoints prevent crossing, not crush or displacement.
reviewedEffects.limitations: No separate sight/attack/spell line through the door, unattended mass flow, projectiles, fluids, unlimited travelers or free transport of remote contents. No cross-plane operation is supplied by the Planar tag. Lost concentration/suppression prevents transit; it never queues a body halfway through. Treat transit atomically at the physical commitment; actual support loss afterward uses normal falling.
reviewedEffects.crossPlanePermission: NO: exact reviewed procedure is local; Planar tag does not grant cross-plane operation.
reviewedEffects.clockRule: No automatic Opening/Horn pause or time conversion supplied.
reviewedEffects.returnRule: No implied return beyond the one exact local relocation/transit.
reviewedEffects.endpointDependency: Two seen, line-of-effect, unoccupied endpoint apertures, each within 30 ft and no more than 30 ft apart.

reviewedEffects.name: Blink Step
reviewedEffects.scope: NEW trigger: immediately after an attack targeting the caster has completely resolved, hit or miss, while the caster is still conscious/able to take a Reaction. It does not undo that attack/damage, prevent its concentration save or revive an incapacitated caster. Spend the actual permitted Reaction, components and RP; then teleport to a perceived unoccupied space with actual body/gear fit and line of effect.
reviewedEffects.limitations: No arbitrary off-turn window, pre-hit cancellation, automatic escape from an explicit anti-teleport restraint or dimensional prison, extra reaction, copied body or portal. Speed 0 alone does not prevent teleport when no independent source does. Actual legal cargo and support/fall state remain; no unseen destination/map knowledge. Countering/blocked release refunds nothing.

interfaceRulesRetained: Faction Portal is the demonstrated cross-plane receiving-headquarters procedure; do not impose a blanket ban on planar travel.
A service price or named portal is not travel permission. EX58 OP-04 requires an operative effect plus endpoint/capacity.
Planar tags and descriptive plane names do not expand an effect beyond its authored procedure.
Existing specific procedures do not silently decide extraction, taxes, claims, clocks, rest, cargo clearance, soul routing, or return.
